remarks: Welcome to this spacious 4-bedroom, 4 full and 2 half bath colonial nestled on 2.54 acres of flat, expansive property. This beautifully designed home features custom moldings throughout and offers exceptional living space for both everyday comfort and elegant entertaining. The spacious kitchen is a chef's dream with an oversized center island, stainless steel appliances, marble countertops, generous pantry, and a bright dining area. The kitchen flows seamlessly into a cozy family room and formal dining room. With four fireplaces throughout, warmth and charm abound. The main level also includes a mudroom, laundry room, and a home office with custom built-ins and fireplace. The impressive recreation room boasts a vaulted ceiling and fireplace. It's large enough for a golf simulator! The finished wine cellar adds a touch of luxury. Step outside to an oversized patio featuring a full outdoor kitchen and fireplace, overlooking a private backyard with room to add a potential pool. A rare opportunity!
